Name: Cave Weather - Dynamic Mine Events and Underground Phenomena
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[b][center][color=#ffff00][size=6]🌑 Cave Weather – Dynamic Mine Events🌑
[/size]
[/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]🔥Support 13 languages😎👌
[/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=downloads][/url][/center]


[/b][b][color=#00ffff]Tired of predictable mine floors?
[/color][/b]
[b]Cave Weather[/b] adds [i]five dynamic, lore-friendly underground phenomena[/i] that can occur once per day, changing the feel, pace, and danger of exploring the mines.

Every day has a chance for a random underground “weather type.” The first time you enter the mines that day, you’ll receive a short message describing the anomaly.

After that, the effects take place seamlessly in gameplay.

[line][b][color=#00ff00][size=4]📌 Features — 5 Unique Cave Weathers
[/size][/color]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39916/39916-1764903358-613573051.png[/img]



[/b]Each cave weather appears [b]rarely[/b] and only [b]one per day[/b].

[line][b][color=#ffff00]🍄 Fungal Harvest [/color]    [/b][i]A gentle, earthy bloom deep below the surface.
[/i]
[b]Effects:[/b]
[list]
[*]Extra mushrooms spawn on the floor around the player when entering a new level.
[*]Green & Big Slimes occasionally drop mushrooms passively.
[*]Ambient drifting [i]mushroom spores[/i] appear in the air.
[/list][b]Gameplay impact:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly safer floors.
[*]Great for foraging & mushroom farming.
[/list][line][b][color=#ffff00]⏳ Temporal Flux  [/color]   [/b][i]Time bends. Movement distorts. Reality stutters.
[/i]
[b]Effects:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Time flows slower[/b] in the mines (configurable).
[*]Monsters alternate between [b]slow-motion[/b] and [b]burst-speed[/b] phases.
[*]Creates unpredictable and chaotic combat moments.
[/list][b]Gameplay impact:[/b]
[list]
[*]Time pressure is eased.
[*]Combat becomes rhythmic and tense.
[/list][line][b][color=#ffff00]⚔️ Berserker Day[/color]     [/b][i]Something in the air enrages the creatures below…
[/i]
[b]Effects:[/b]
[list]
[*]Monsters behave normally [b]until they take damage[/b].
[*]When hit once, they become [i]berserk[/i]:
[list]
[*]+Speed
[*]+Aggression / aggro detection range
[/list][*]To compensate, the player gains [b]+Defense[/b] during Berserker Day.
[/list][b]Gameplay impact:[/b]
[list]
[*]Early hits feel safe—finishing enemies becomes intense.
[*]Encourages hit-and-run or ranged-style combat.
[/list][line][b][color=#ffff00]🌫️ Frenzy Fog  [/color]   [/b][i]A pale fog drifts through the caverns—unnerving but empowering.
[/i]
[b]Effects:[/b]
[list]
[*]All monsters gain a [b]small speed boost[/b].
[*]A soft [b]fog overlay[/b] adds atmosphere.
[*]The player receives a [b]defensive buff[/b] to balance difficulty.
[/list][b]Gameplay impact:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly faster floors, upgraded reactive combat.
[/list][line][b][color=#ffff00]🩸 Bloodthirst Winds  [/color]   [/b][i]You feel a heat in the air… and the monsters do too.
[/i]
[b]Effects:[/b]
[list]
[*]Player suffers [b]reduced defense[/b] during Bloodthirst Winds.
[*]Monsters slowly [b]self-heal over time[/b] (small, periodic regen).
[*]Light [b]red dust particles[/b] swirl through the air.
[/list][b]Gameplay impact:[/b]
[list]
[*]Longer fights if enemies are ignored.
[*]Encourages decisive combat and focus fire.
[/list][line][b][color=#00ffff]⚙️ Configuration (GMCM Support)
[/color]
[/b]If you have [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], you can edit:

[list]
[*]Daily weather chance
[*]Enable/disable each weather
[*]Mushroom spawn intensity
[*]Temporal Flux time speed + burst/slow multipliers
[*]Berserker bonuses & player compensation
[*]Frenzy Fog opacity, monster speed, and player buff
[*]Bloodthirst Winds healing rate & player penalty
[/list]Every weather is 100% optional—disable anything you don’t like.
[line][b][color=#00ffff]📥 Installation[/color][/b][list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]

[*]Install [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]

[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional but recommended)

[*]Drop the [b]CaveWeather[/b] folder into:

[/list]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]
Start the game, and you’re good to go.
[line][b][color=#00ffff]🧪 Compatibility
[/color]
[/b]✔ Fully compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
✔ Works with texture replacers
✔ Works with other combat mods (values may stack)
⚠ Temporal Flux modifies the [i]rate of in-mine time flow[/i]
[list]
[*]It may conflict logically with other [b]time speed[/b] mods
[*]Safe to use, but final timing depends on mod load order
[/list]
[b][color=#00ffff]💬 FAQ
[/color][/b][b]Q: Does this change mine generation?[/b]
No. Only behavior, ambiance, and combat pacing.

[b]Q: Will this overwrite other buffs?[/b]
No. It uses its own invisible, persistent buff ID.

[b]Q: Can I turn off the visual fog?[/b]
Yes—opacity is configurable from 0 to 255.

[b]Q: Does this replace vanilla weather?[/b]
No. Cave Weather is independent and only affects mines & the Volcano Dungeon.

[line][b][color=#00ffff]📗 Credits
[/color]
[/b][list]
[*]Inspired by the idea: [i]“What if caves felt alive each day?”[/i]
[/list][line][b][color=#00ffff]✨ Final Notes
[/color]
[/b]Cave Weather is meant to make each mining day feel different.

Some days are lucky, some dangerous, some strange. None are overpowered—and everything stays true to Stardew’s cozy yet mysterious atmosphere.

If you enjoy it, please endorse the mod on Nexus.

Your support encourages new cave anomalies, events, and expansions.
